searches.note: Twenty one searches of a share of twenty eight, none the author's; two more were spent reading the founder's death and Boutari's 1906 claim and are counted under their records. Six were restricted to a producer's own domain (boutari.gr, kiryianni.gr, thymiopoulosvineyards.gr) and read as primary for the house's own dates and methods. No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: the founding year, the people, the classification, the grapes, the sites, the making, the window, the service, the label, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
What a search contradicted was set right with its source; what rested on one secondary source or none was cut.
Sources whose title or address names a living person (karakasis.mw among them) were met among the results and are cited neither in the fragment nor here.

tested: 1879 founding, 1906 cellar and Naoussa Boutari bottled red, 1935 exports under the founder's son, 1978 Stenimachos winery: boutari.gr history (search, domain restricted, two searches) and Wine With Seth; the 1978 date stands, one summary that put Stenimachos in 1935 misread the timeline.

Grande Reserve making: boutari.gr wine page (seven days on skins, malolactic, two years in French oak and two in the cellars) and retailers; it names selected plots of Trilofos, so the sites were set right.
Grande Reserve as a legal term: four years in all for a red in Guildsomm study material and the wein-plus guide; the split between cask and bottle varies by source and stays out.
The 2022 deal: OT.gr, CNN Greece and the house's history (became a member of the Sterner Stenhus Greece group); told as a joining, not a sale, and no owner named.
changed: wine.sites: was selected vineyards across the Naoussa appellation; now separately selected plots around Trilofos, as the house's own page for the wine says (boutari.gr, Grande Reserve Naoussa).
story: the grapes now come from selected plots around Trilofos, by the same page.
story: the glass bottles of 1879 cut, a claim of one press account (Protothema) and no second; the house's own first bottled red of 1906 stands, hedged.
story: was sold to an investment group in 2022; now became part of an investment group, by its own history, since the deal was a consolidation (boutari.gr history, OT.gr, CNN Greece).
sources: the Protothema account, now unused, replaced by CNN Greece on the 2022 deal.
open: The founder's dates (Ioannis Boutaris) were not found, so he stays described.

tested: 1968 purchase, Xinomavro planted about 1970, the 1995 Boutari Estate in Yianakohori of the 1992 vintage (Xinomavro with Merlot), the 1997 founding and the first vintage in the converted tractor shed: kiryianni.gr history (domain restricted).
Ramnista: royal hill and buckthorn both on kiryianni.gr; barrels of 225 and 500 litres French oak on the house's sheets, 14 to 18 months by vintage; one importer adds American oak.
Diaporos: Block 5 Xinomavro with about an eighth Syrah, PGI Imathia, house fact sheets and Enotria and Coe.
The founder's death: 9 November 2024, aged 82 (kiryianni.gr farewell page, iefimerida, To Vima, Greek City Times).
changed: story: the 1968 purchase stands (kiryianni.gr history); the planting of Merlot beside it in 1968 cut, as the house dates its Xinomavro planting to about 1970 and gives no Merlot planting year.
story: the 1995 Boutari Estate in Yianakohori now named as the 1992 vintage, by the house's history page.
others: Diaporos was a single vineyard red from the Naoussa blocks; now Block 5 Xinomavro with a little Syrah, labelled PGI Imathia, by the house's fact sheets and its importer (Enotria and Coe).
open: The founder died on 9 November 2024 (1942 to 2024; kiryianni.gr farewell page, iefimerida, To Vima); people.json still lists him as living. He stays described here; the read-together agent or the integrator may lift him from people.json and name him with his dates.
Ramnista's barrels: the house says French oak of 225 and 500 litres; one importer says French and American. The record keeps the house's word.

tested: Earth and Sky: 45 year old vines, seven tenths Trilofos at 150 to 250 metres and three tenths Fytia at 450 to 650 metres, eighteen months in third use 500 litre French barrels: thymiopoulosvineyards.gr (domain restricted).
First wine: 2005 on the house's page; the vintage is 2003 or 2004 elsewhere (wein-plus, importers), released 2005; the record now dates the release.
Naoussa Alta and Terra Olympus with Terra Petra in Rapsani: importers and a wine.com label naming Terra Olympus.
changed: story and card: was he made the first wine in 2005; now the first wine came out in 2005, since the sources give the first vintage as 2003 or 2004, released in 2005 (wein-plus glossary, the house's story page, importers).
story: the range of ten Xinomavro wines cut, a count that moves.

others: Naoussa Alta was from a high block on schist; now from the house's highest vineyards at 450 to 650 metres, as importers give it; the soil is told as slate and granite, so schist alone was cut.
open: The first vintage of Earth and Sky (2003 or 2004) is not settled, so the record dates only the release.

tested: 1840 and the surviving contract: Greek Gastronomy Guide and Wines of Greece; organic since 1996, BioHellas: the same two.
Biodynamic from 2008: Greek Gastronomy Guide only, cut; visitors in 1998: found nowhere, cut.
Paliokalias 2009: refuted; a tasting report of a Master of Wine gives a maiden vintage of 1997 and the younger generation's first vintage as 2011, and VOS Selections gives 2011 too.
changed: story, card and trap: was Paliokalias first bottled apart with the 2009 vintage; that date is refuted, since a tasting of the wine's vertical began with a maiden vintage of 1997 and the younger generation's first vintage was 2011 (VOS Selections and a Master of Wine's tasting report, whose site names a living writer and so is not cited). The record now dates the younger generation's first vintage, 2011, and gives Paliokalias no first year.
story: the opening to visitors in 1998 cut, found in no source; biodynamic methods from 2008 cut, one source (Greek Gastronomy Guide) and no second.
story: organic since 1996 now certified by BioHellas (Greek Gastronomy Guide; Wines of Greece names BIOHellas).
open: Paliokalias's first vintage, 1997 in one tasting report only, is not taught; the family's purchase of the vineyard about 1960 is in the same one source and stays out.

tested: 1980 planting, 1994 winery in the middle of the vineyard, the son joining soon after, Ano Gastra: Greece and Grapes, Wine With Seth, Skurnik.

Making: cold soak, steel, malolactic in concrete confirmed by two retailers; the oak length and the share of new wood disagree (45 per cent new in Tacoma, no new wood in Skurnik and Wine With Seth), so the record says well over a year in French oak.
changed: wine.making: was a year and a half in French oak, a share of them new; now well over a year in French oak, since the sources disagree on the length (14 to 16 months, a year and a half, two years) and on new wood (45 per cent new in one, no new wood in two others: Tacoma Wine Merchants, Skurnik, Wine With Seth).
wine.glass: vanilla from the barrel cut, since new oak is in doubt.

story: put in order (1971 before 1980 and 1994); the importers in the United States, Britain and Germany cut, found in no source of this check; the winery now built in the middle of the vineyard and the son joining soon after (Wine With Seth, Skurnik).
open: The share of new oak in the Karydas Naoussa is unsettled between importers.

deceasedFound: Yiannis Boutaris, the founder of Kir-Yianni, died on 9 November 2024 (13 June 1942 to 9 November 2024), by the house's farewell page and three Greek news sources; people.json lists him and should lose him, and he may then be named with his dates. The record keeps him described.
swaps: No swap was proposed, and none is ruled. For the read-together agent: the plan's why for Karydas says Gastra and first wines of 1992; this check confirms Ano Gastra and the winery and first own wine of 1994 (Greece and Grapes, Wine With Seth, Skurnik), so the why wants those words. The plan's why for Thymiopoulos speaks of whole bunch, gently extracted Xinomavro, which this check did not test.
questions: All ten questions keep one right answer with distractors of one kind. Thymiopoulos's story question now says released; Dalamara's card and trap moved from the refuted 2009 to the 2011 vintage and the meaning of 1840.
codexTension: The library record of Thymiopoulos (p-thymiopoulos) speaks of whole bunch lift; nothing in this check tested it, and the record does not repeat it.
The region record's producer line for Karydas calls it a one wine grower; it also makes the Syllektiko blend (the author's two retailers), as the author reported. Reported, not edited.
The region record names Ioannis Boutaris with 1879 but no dates; his dates were found nowhere.
